I’m starting to share more of this stuff because I want to give real, incremental value on this silly app. Not just highlight reels, but the lessons and mindset that actually move the needle in business and life. If that’s something you’re into, follow along. Let’s grow together.

@bigdogranchrescue transported him down to South Florida, where we got to meet 😁 they told us he was one of the most abused dogs in the shelter. He still has some trauma today from loud noises, aggression or screaming, and other dogs. 

we’ve almost had him for a full year, and it’s a blessing to see his true personality come out. He’s the ultimate surf dog.
